items.summary:
Authorization bypass through User-Controlled key vulnerability in İdeal Data Finansal Teknolojiler A.Ş. IDeal WEB allows Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs.

This issue affects iDeal WEB: before v1.82.

A vulnerability was determined in dayrui XunRuiCMS up to 4.7.4. The affected element is the function config_add of the file dayrui/App/Cms/Extends/Admin/Category.php of the component Category Handler. This manipulation of the argument list_field causes code injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.
In Eclipse Jetty, the JSON parsing utilities provided by artifact `jetty-util-ajax` are vulnerable to `StackOverflowError` for inputs that have a large recursive structure.

Cross Site Request Forgery protections are improperly configured in jspwiki.war in Apache JSPWIKI 3.0.0 on all platforms allows attacker to bypass protections for CSRF. A work around exists for existing deployments.
Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 which fixes this issue.

Session Fixation in the login flow of Apache JSPWiki versions 2.10 through 3.0.0 on all platforms. The session identifier was not replaced when a user authenticated, so an attacker who could set a known session identifier in the browser of a victim could use the same identifier after the victim logged in.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 (3.x) or 2.12.6 (2.x), which fix this issue.

Token Exposure in AttachmentTab.jsp in Apache JSPWIKI in the effected version on all platforms exposes the Cross Site Request Forgery protected token via the address bar.




Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.0.1 which fixes this issue.
